features.title: Automatically settle eligible idle threads
features.summary: Apply an opt-in idle policy with per-thread overrides while excluding active, blank, pinned, parked, settled, and explicitly excluded sessions and workspaces. Subagent threads idle for `subagentSettleHours` (24 by default) settle on their own and their running background jobs are stopped. The Host scans on the configured interval, so threads settle with no browser open; other plugins ask it to settle a thread for their own trigger through the auto-settle-api contract, and thread_auto_settle_status reads the last and next scan and the newest automatic settles. Settling is the plugin's own status: the thread stays listed and openable, the native archive verb is never called, and the Host pre-step gate stops its model steps until it is unsettled.
